annotations.title: Validate and geocode a Dutch address (paid)

description: Netherlands address verification and geocoding (adres, postcode + huisnummer): send a postcode + house number or free text, get the official address from the national BAG register (does it exist, exact spelling), WGS84 latitude/longitude, BAG ids, municipality, province and CBS neighbourhood code. Cheap address validation for KYC, onboarding, delivery, CRM cleanup and real estate agents. Source: Kadaster BAG via PDOK. Costs 0.002 USDC via x402, or 1 credit of a Factline API key.

q.description: Alternative to postcode: free-text address, e.g. 'Visschersplein 1 Utrecht'
